description.menstrual: Period. Energy is often lower; comfort, rest and low-key plans tend to go down well.
description.follicular: Energy and mood commonly rise. A good time for new plans, activity and socialising.
description.ovulation: Often the most outgoing and confident days, with the highest libido of the cycle.
description.earlyLuteal: Energy usually settles. Calmer, cosier plans tend to suit this stretch.
description.lateLuteal: PMS days: irritability, tiredness or low mood are common. Extra patience helps.
